===Etymology 1===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*bojь}}, from {{inh|ru|ine-pro|*bʰoyh₂ós}}, from {{m|ine-pro|*bʰeyh₂-|t=to strike, hew}}. Cognate with {{m|ru|бить|t=to beat}}, with typical Indo-European nominal ''o''-[[ablaut]].

====Noun====
{{ru-noun+|c|loc=в +|par=+|adj=боево́й}}

# [[beating]], [[breakage]]
# [[battle]], [[combat]], [[engagement]]
#: {{uxi|ru|[[рукопа́шный]] '''бой'''|hand-to-hand '''fight(ing)/combat'''}}
# [[fight]], [[fighting]], [[struggle]]
# [[striking]] ''(of a clock)''

=====Declension=====
{{ru-noun-table|c|loc=в +|par=+1|notes=1 Only in the expression {{m|ru|брать с бо́ю||to take by force, to seize}}.}}
